title: The 18-Minute Mystery
subtitle: What's Sending Signals Every 18 Minutes?
description:
What's Sending Signals Every 18 Minutes?

In 2022 astronomers in Australia found an object that flashed radio waves every 18 minutes, for about a minute at a time. Nothing known behaved quite like it.

Follow for daily trips through the universe. 🚀

#spacemystery #space #astronomy #astronomy #shorts #science

segments.text: Something in our galaxy was flashing radio waves at us, every eighteen minutes.
In 2022, astronomers in Australia were going through old data from a radio telescope in the desert.
segments.headline: Hidden in old data

segments.text: They found a source that switched on for about a minute, then off. Again and again.
It was about four thousand light-years away, and for a while it was one of the brightest radio sources in that part of the sky.
Pulsars flash too, but in seconds or less. Nobody had seen anything this slow.
segments.headline: Too slow for a pulsar

segments.text: It could be a strange kind of magnetar, or a white dwarf. Or something we haven't imagined.
segments.headline: What is it?

segments.text: Since then, astronomers have found more of these slow flashers. And the mystery isn't fully solved.
